content_zh:
成为加西亚公爵的骑士需要两名资深骑士推荐，邢烨在骑士队长和莫尔斯的带领下去见加西亚公爵。
“不会。”邢烨保持着自己的冷脸状态。
骑士队长看了邢烨一眼，过了一会儿又偷看一眼，邢烨权当没看见。
“劳伦斯，你今天有点不一样。”走到门前，骑士队长忍不住说道。
“大概是因为我刚洗过澡吧。”邢烨道。
足足十天没洗澡，彻底清洗过后当然会改头换面。
“难怪，好香……”莫尔斯凑近闻了闻，“你是用了公爵府的香水吗？”
他明明披着斗篷，连鞋子都没露出来，这两个人怎么变成这样？金手指的力量真是强大。
“不知道。”邢烨维持着冷冷的人设，轻轻敲门，得到许可后，进入房门。
加西亚公爵是个三十多岁的男子，身材健壮，眼神锐利，比卢卡公爵强多了。
骑士队长单膝跪地，手掌抵在心口上，对加西亚公爵道：“公爵殿下，这位就是冒险者劳伦斯，他的身手非常好，如果真的生死决斗，我不是他的对手。”
“沃克骑士，我最欣赏的就是你的诚实与公正，”加西亚公爵放下手中的酒杯，将骑士队长扶起来，“我相信你的引荐，只要骑士团的人没有意见，我立刻授予他一等骑士的勋章。”
骑士队长真心地感谢道：“多谢您的信任。”
很会拉拢人心，邢烨观察着加西亚公爵，这是一个有野心的人。
在抵达这个房间之前，邢烨还没有决定是否成为加西亚公爵的骑士，在确认这人并非草包后，他下定了决心。
“公爵殿下，”邢烨微微行礼，对加西亚公爵道，“在成为骑士之前，我有件事需要单独向您汇报。在听到这件事后，您还是愿意接纳我，那我会向您献出我的生命。”
“无礼之人！”加西亚公爵身后的管家斥道，“我们怎么可能让你一个身份不明的人与公爵单独相处？”
骑士队长连忙道：“我用生命担保，劳伦斯是一个热诚善良正直的骑士，他绝不会伤害公爵！”
邢烨：“……”
沃克骑士昏头了吧？管家的怀疑很合理啊！他一个身手好又来历不明的人，要求与公爵单独相处，万一是刺客怎么办？

邢烨其实不太相信镜子说的“没有男人能拒绝你的魅力”，毕竟这些日子骑士团的人对他也没有多特殊。此时穿上女装，只是为了制造女王和加西亚公爵之间的矛盾而已，然而效果比他想象得要好太多。
不仅是沃克骑士，莫尔斯也以人格担保，劳伦斯是多么优秀正直。
“我当然相信你们，”加西亚公爵和善地将两位骑士扶起来，“我愿意给劳伦斯一个机会。”
同时他对一脸担忧的老管家说道：“你也要相信我的实力，我并不是那种只会吃喝玩乐背弃了祖先传统的贵族，十年前，我还获得过王国第一剑士的荣耀。”
两句话将骑士和管家安抚住，化解他们之间的矛盾，同时暗中警告邢烨，别以为单独相处就能为所欲为，他的实力并不弱。
很快房间内只剩下邢烨与加西亚公爵，他举着红酒杯，另一只手放在剑柄上，状似悠然实则警惕地对邢烨说：“你有什么秘密？”
邢烨握了下拳，他虽然早就计划好了，心中还是稍稍有抵触感。但此时也顾不得这么多了，他向来是个为了胜利可以不择手段的人，不过是女装，这不算什么。
邢烨与加西亚公爵保持着安全距离，放柔声音，轻声道：“我会向公爵展现出自己最大的诚意，也请公爵帮助我保守秘密。”
“哦？你能有什么秘密？”加西亚公爵提起一丝兴趣。
邢烨慢慢解开颈间的扣子，斗篷滑落，露出下面的蕾丝蓬蓬裙。
这并不是一件多么华丽的衣服，邢烨在集市上也不过是随便选了一件衣服而已。它的颜色不够艳丽，衣料看起来十分廉价，但穿在邢烨身上，却有种在发光感觉。
邢烨提起裙摆，向眼珠子快掉出来的加西亚公爵行了一个优雅的女士礼，柔声道：“这就是我最大的秘密了，这样的我，能够成为公爵大人的骑士吗？”
加西亚公爵愣了好几秒才缓过神来：“你、你怎么会……不过看你的脸也确实很美丽，不对，沃克骑士说你的身手极好？这……”

content_en:
Becoming a knight of Duke Garcia requires the recommendation of two senior knights. Xing Ye, led by the knight captain and Morse, went to see Duke Garcia.
"No." Xing Ye kept his cold face.
The knight captain glanced at Xing Ye, and after a while he peeked again, but Xing Ye pretended not to see him.
"Lawrence, you are a little different today." Walking to the door, the knight captain couldn't help but said.
"Maybe it's because I just took a shower." Xing Ye said.
I haven’t taken a shower for ten days, so after a thorough cleansing, I will definitely change my appearance.
"No wonder, it smells so good..." Morse came closer and smelled it, "Did you use the perfume from the Duke's Palace?"
He was obviously wearing a cloak and didn't even show his shoes. How did these two people become like this? The power of Goldfinger is really powerful.
"I don't know." Xing Ye maintained his cold persona, knocked on the door gently, and after getting permission, entered the door.
Duke Garcia is a man in his thirties, with a strong build and sharp eyes, much stronger than Duke Luca.
The knight captain knelt down on one knee, put his palm on his heart, and said to Duke Garcia: "Your Highness, this is the adventurer Lawrence. His skills are very good. If there is a life and death duel, I am not his opponent."
"Knight Walker, what I appreciate most is your honesty and fairness." Duke Garcia put down the wine glass in his hand and helped the knight captain up. "I believe in your recommendation. As long as the people of the knights have no objections, I will immediately award him the medal of a first-class knight."
The knight captain thanked me sincerely: "Thank you for your trust."
He was very good at winning people's hearts. Xing Ye observed Duke Garcia. He was an ambitious man.
Before arriving in this room, Xing Ye had not yet decided whether to become Duke Garcia's knight. After confirming that this man was not a fool, he made up his mind.
"Your Highness the Duke," Xing Ye saluted slightly and said to Duke Garcia, "Before I become a knight, I have something to report to you alone. After hearing this, if you are still willing to accept me, then I will dedicate my life to you."
"Discourteous person!" scolded the butler behind Duke Garcia, "How could we let you, an unknown person, be alone with the Duke?"
The knight captain said quickly: "I guarantee with my life that Lawrence is a sincere, kind and upright knight, and he will never hurt the Duke!"
Xing Ye: "..."
Is Walker Knight confused? The steward's suspicion is very reasonable! He, a man of great skill and unknown origin, asked to be alone with the Duke. What if he was an assassin?
Xing Ye actually didn't quite believe what the mirror said, "No man can refuse your charm." After all, the people in the Knights didn't treat him very special these days. Wearing women's clothing at this time was just to create a conflict between the Queen and Duke Garcia, but the effect was much better than he imagined.
Not only was Walker Knight, but Morse also vouched for his character, how good and upright Lawrence was.
"Of course I believe you," Duke Garcia kindly helped the two knights up, "I am willing to give Lawrence a chance."
At the same time, he said to the worried old butler: "You also have to believe in my strength. I am not the kind of noble who only eats, drinks and has fun and abandons the traditions of my ancestors. Ten years ago, I won the honor of being the best swordsman in the kingdom."
Two words comforted the knight and the butler and resolved the conflict between them. At the same time, he secretly warned Xing Ye not to think that he could do whatever he wanted when alone, as he was not weak.
Soon, only Xing Ye and Duke Garcia were left in the room. He held up the red wine glass and put his other hand on the hilt of his sword. He looked carefree but actually said to Xing Ye warily: "What secret do you have?"
Xing Ye clenched his fist. Although he had already planned it, he still felt a little conflicted in his heart. But he didn't care about so much at this time. He had always been a person who would do whatever it took to win, but it was just women's clothing, so it didn't matter.Xing Ye kept a safe distance from Duke Garcia, lowered his voice, and said softly: "I will show my greatest sincerity to the Duke, and ask the Duke to help me keep the secret."
"Oh? What secrets can you have?" Duke Garcia showed a hint of interest.
Xing Ye slowly unbuttoned his neck, and his cloak slipped off, revealing the lace tutu underneath.
This is not a very gorgeous piece of clothing. Xing Ye just chose a piece of clothing at random in the market. The color is not bright enough, and the material looks very cheap, but when it is worn on Xing Ye, it feels like it is shining.
Xing Ye lifted up his skirt and gave an elegant lady's salute to Duke Garcia, whose eyes were about to pop out. He said softly: "This is my biggest secret. Can I become the Duke's knight?"
Duke Garcia was stunned for several seconds before he regained his composure: "You, how could you... But your face is indeed very beautiful, no, Knight Walker said that you have excellent skills? This..."
